name: japan-mynumber-card-check
description: Free checker for when a Japan My Number Card (マイナンバーカード) expires and what to do: foreign residents' cards end with the period of stay (no auto-extension on visa renewal), city-hall extension deadline, one-time 2-month extension while a renewal is pending, renewal window (11th birthday), e-certificate and マイナ保険証 grace, 特定在留カード. Keyless JSON API + MCP.
